name: Egg and bean breakfast burritos
summary: Soft scrambled eggs, black beans, red pepper, onion and spinach with a little cheddar and fresh tomato salsa, rolled in wholewheat tortillas.
about: Breakfast burritos, eggs and fillings rolled in a flour tortilla, come from the American Southwest, especially New Mexico. Rolled up and frozen, they are a breakfast that reheats in a few minutes on a busy morning.
steps: Mix the tomatoes, coriander and lemon juice for the salsa, season with salt and set aside.

Heat the oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Fry the onion and red pepper, stirring now and then, for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

Add the black beans and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, lightly crushing about a third of them with the back of a spoon, until hot. Add the spinach and stir for 1 minute, until wilted. Tip into a bowl and wipe out the pan.
Beat the eggs with the salt. Pour into the pan over low heat and stir slowly with a spatula for 2 to 3 minutes, until just set in soft, creamy curds. Take off the heat straight away.
Warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry frying pan over medium heat for about 20 seconds a side, until soft and pliable.

Spoon a line of the bean mixture down the middle of each tortilla, top with egg, cheese and a spoon of salsa, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. For a crisp outside, put them seam side down in the hot dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes, until golden. Cut in half and serve.
prepNote: Roll without the salsa, wrap each in foil and freeze for 2 months; reheat from frozen in foil at 180 °C for 25 minutes.
